tokens: "%s: Oh, fair and radiant sun, how I bask in your warm embrace.\n"
"%s: Begone, small and insignificant planet! I have no time for your foolishness.\n"
"%s: What say you, Venus? Surely you too must appreciate the sun's splendor.\n"
"%s: I do not concern myself with such trivial matters. I prefer to focus on my own beauty.\n"
"%s: Ah, but do not forget my charm, dear Venus. I am truly the most beautiful of them all.\n"
"%s: Please, Earth. You may be pleasant enough to look at, but you cannot compare to my elegance.\n"
"%s: And what of my might, my strength? Who among us can match the power of Mars?\n"
"%s: Your violence does not impress me, Mars. It is only through cooperation and harmony that we thrive.\n"
"%s: I must agree with Earth. Our unity gives us strength, unlike your petty conflicts, Mars.\n"
"%s: Silence, all of you! Your petty squabbles are nothing compared to my grandeur and majesty!\n"
"%s: Do not be so quick to underestimate our power, Jupiter. It is together that we are strongest.\n"
"%s: Hear, hear! Unity is key, especially in these times of uncertainty.\n"
"%s: Yes, let us not forget our bonds. It is only together that we can succeed.\n"
"Maximum distance between any two planets: %f meters.\n"
